title: Central Spire
body:
The tower core, seat of Apex Spire. Vertical control, pristine data, status measured by altitude.

STUB — derived from the #central-spire channel and the Apex Spire faction brief. Needs authoring: what a scene here looks and smells like, who staffs it, what a player can actually do.

title: Reflection District
body:
Territory of the Reflection Syndics, where identity, likeness and history are bought and sold. Mirror-dealers, face-laundering, records made to stop existing.

STUB — derived from the #reflection-district channel and the Reflection Syndics brief. Needs authoring.

title: The Undercircuit
body:
Below the rainline: worker warrens, maintenance corridors, data-centres sunk into bedrock.

STUB — derived from the #undercircuit channel and the buried-infrastructure layer of the world briefing. Needs authoring.
NOTE: the daemon separately invented an "Undercroft" (2026-01-03) serving the same role. Merge the names or distinguish them.

title: Street Level
body:
The top layer most citizens see: storefront shells, ad-saturated sidewalks, biometric doors, rain.

STUB — derived from the #street-level channel and the world briefing's surface layer. Needs authoring.

title: Neon Lounge
body:
A social space on the surface layer — where people who do not want to be logged go to be seen anyway.

STUB — derived from the #neon-lounge channel. Nothing authored yet; the reading above is inference from the name alone. Confirm or replace.

title: Market Loop
body:
Trade circuit — goods, shells, parts, favours.

STUB — derived from the #market-loop channel. Inference from the name alone. Confirm or replace.

title: Dreamlink
body:
A mesh space rather than a physical one.

STUB — derived from the #dreamlink channel. Likely connects to Driftwave and the Neurosonic material, and possibly to the low-power shell practices of the Cygnus, but nothing authored confirms this. Confirm or replace.

title: City Signal
body:
The public signal-layer over the city — where GhostNet pulses are audible to anyone listening.

STUB — derived from the #city-signal channel and the briefing's signal-layer. Needs authoring.
